experiment: AntMaze V6 mainline: equal-weight multi-future supervision (arm MF: the sealed simulator draw + draw 2, one chosen uniformly per positive) vs the single-draw arms CF / CF2, O, the hybrid and the start agent; five paired seeds

futures.law: anchor by weight (unchanged); table j uniform over the two; m ~ gamma^m over 1..L_j - 1 within table j; every outcome kept; no splicing
futures.rng: the one future uniform is split (j = floor(2u), u' = 2u - j): anchor sequence identical to the single-table arms

arms.MF: critic futures = both tables, equal weight

evaluation.targets: MF seeds 0-4 on the same 300 episodes as CF / CF2 / O / hybrid / start

judgement.mainline_rule: MF - O: mean > 2 x seed s.e. and 5 / 5 (reported)
readings_kept_open: (a) MF at or above the better draw's mean (0.449) with a narrower seed spread than either draw: two futures per anchor stabilise the supervision
(b) MF between the two draws' means (0.351 .. 0.449): averaging without stabilisation
(c) MF at or below the lower draw (0.351): more futures per anchor do not help under this recipe
judgement.no_selection: every final evaluated once; no tuning after the result
